lede: Mountain Village Council meets Thursday with real decisions on the table: a second-reading ordinance that rewires how the Mountain Village Housing Authority sets its fees — moving from hardcoded figures to an annual fee schedule — plus a companion resolution locking in the actual 2027 MVHA rates, including Village Court. Meanwhile, Norwood holds a public hearing Thursday on whether to remove a sitting Planning Commission member, which is rare enough in a small town to warrant attention. The Telluride Horror Show runs Friday through Sunday at the Sheridan Opera House, with a liquor licensing public hearing Tuesday for the Palm Theatre permits covering up to 1,400 attendees per day.
